lines: [steel, controlled] No, Adam. A mistake is forgetting an anniversary. You built two lives... and lied to everyone in both of them.
[charming laugh] Honey, you're the numbers person. I'm the people person.
[panicking] This is insane! Lauren, think about Ben and Maya!
[quiet, steady] Hi, Adam. [pause] Should I tell her about your divorce... or should you?
[gently] Yes. [pause] But you did follow him. And now we get to choose how this ends.
[flat, unhurried] Adam Morgan. Detective Ortiz, Chicago PD. You're under arrest for bank fraud and forgery.
[excited] Dad! Look! It's the one I wanted!
